name: JSpark3 v1
product_type: reproducible three-DGX-Spark serving and runtime recipe for GLM-5.3 Flash; the GitHub recipe is not a weights redistribution and is paired with a public, attributed, byte-identical Hugging Face mirror of the pinned target checkpoint

v1.0.0.note: Frozen historical record. The v1.0.0 release facts are preserved byte-identically; v1.0.0 evidence stays labeled historical.

publication_sequencing: Merge to main, the v1.1.0 tag, the GitHub release, and the Hugging Face card push are separate coordinated operations, never an atomic transaction. The v1.1.0 tag does not exist yet; install references name it and fail until it exists, with no default-branch fallback.

payloads.github_repository: v1.1.0 (Cadence) staged for publication, not tagged and not released; the historical v1.0.0 release shipped 2026-09-02 and is recorded under historical.v1.0.0; source repository public at https://github.com/jakejharris/jspark3; this tree except huggingface/ and dist/
payloads.huggingface_repository: public attributed target-weight mirror at https://huggingface.co/jakejharris/jspark3, remotely verified and merged into main at e7c34dba923916754cfcb0bdf6c2c75a9b7ff1fc
payloads.release_assets: dist/ produced by tools/build_release_assets.sh (recipe tarball, checksums, SBOM)
payloads.container_image: v1.0.0 uses the exact upstream image by digest; docker/ is local-reproducibility material only and no JSpark3 GHCR image will be published

container_distribution.redistribution_policy: do not redistribute a local build without independently satisfying NVIDIA and upstream terms

license: Apache-2.0 for original code and prose; third-party terms per THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md and REQUIRED_ATTRIBUTION.md

weights_mirror.status: published and remotely verified on public main
weights_mirror.destination_policy: existing Hugging Face pull-request revision only; never main
weights_mirror.merge_policy: manual only after exact remote verification

verification_evidence.scope: One integrated same-candidate admission pass. Maximum context, sustained concurrency, independent-fleet reproduction and Pi slowdown remain unresolved; final review and publication are separate decisions.
